findings.excerpt_quote: * ~~Roles need to be ready to work with virtual resources~~ ... This shall automatically work with the Virtual Resources - VR gets assigned to a team as a team member, and they will be able to get a role just like a regular Individual ... In BigPicture you will be able to assign virtual resources with a role, to estimated required capacity per each role.
findings.finding_summary: The description gives three different signals about virtual-resource (VR) role support: an 'Includes' bullet crossing the item out (implying it's not a distinct deliverable), a 'Scope of work' note saying VR gets a role 'automatically' via team membership, and a Usecase note promising VR role assignment for capacity estimation. No sentence in the epic's own text reconciles the strikethrough with the other two — a reader has to infer that the strikethrough means 'not a separate workstream' rather than 'not in scope.'
findings.testing_impact: QA cannot decide whether virtual-resource role assignment needs its own dedicated test, or is already covered incidentally by regular team-membership role tests, until the scope question is answered.
findings.question_for_PM: Is virtual-resource role assignment actually in scope for vol1 (delivered automatically via team membership, per the 'Scope of work' note), or was it descoped as the struck-through 'Includes' bullet implies — and if delivered automatically, was that behaviour ever verified end-to-end?

findings.excerpt_quote: XLSX files contain individuals instead of roles. To be decided by the PM: whether we should support only PDF export or update the XLSX export for other view modes as well (Skills, Projects, Multi-team assignment).
findings.finding_summary: This is an open product decision, raised by QA during acceptance testing on child task TC-6605 ('[QA Acceptance] Role-based resource management', status Done), that is never answered anywhere in the epic's own analyzed text — including the newly-fetched Confluence roadmap page, which does not mention export format at all. The epic itself states 'Roles are supported in BT exports' as a committed Includes item, but the acceptance evidence says the XLSX export path currently shows individuals, not roles — directly bearing on whether that Includes item is actually met.
findings.testing_impact: QA cannot mark the 'Roles supported in BT exports' capability as fully tested until the PM confirms whether XLSX must show roles, or PDF-only is the accepted scope for vol1.
findings.question_for_PM: Has the XLSX-vs-PDF export-format decision raised in TC-6605 been made? If XLSX still shows individuals instead of roles, is 'Roles are supported in BT exports' considered met for vol1, partially met (PDF only), or open?

findings.excerpt_quote: Tests are not complited, because of bug ONE-380032 (Only the correct display of workload and capacity for the set role on the task without assignee was checked)... Because that bug I didn't check scenario mode

findings.question_for_PM: Has role-based workload/capacity calculation been re-verified in 'scenario mode' since bug ONE-380032 was fixed, and was the Canceled testing story (ONE-337416) intentionally dropped or replaced by something not visible in this inventory?
